subject: Future Tech
title: Why Fusion Matters
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Why Fusion Matters.

hook.text: The sun fuses 600 million tons of hydrogen every second. If we could copy that on Earth, energy scarcity ends forever.

buildup.text: Fossil fuels pollute. Renewables are intermittent. Fission creates waste. Fusion promises clean, limitless power.

discovery.text: One gram of fusion fuel produces energy equal to burning 8 tons of oil, with no carbon and minimal radioactive waste.

twist.text: Scientists have chased fusion since the 1950s. The joke: it's always 30 years away. But recent breakthroughs are real.

climax.text: In 2022, the NIF achieved ignition: more energy out than in. The physics works. Now it's an engineering challenge.

punchline.text: Fusion isn't a dream anymore. It's a deadline.

quiz.question: What milestone did the NIF achieve in 2022?
options: Fusion ignition: more energy out than in
